reason: message_start opens the portable message lifecycle; the adapter allocates its own message identity and emits nothing for the frame.
message_end closes the provider message and restates the turn's stop reason; it is not a run terminal and carries no OAP envelope.
turn_end is a per-turn provider-scoped diagnostic (spec 13.4.2, 3.5); the run terminal is arbitrated from agent_result and agent_end only.
